entries.variant: 'pure chalcanthite', 9.6 mg (also 5.2 and 28.7 mg), alumina crucible

source.authors: Duan, X.; Li, N.; Wang, Y.; Tang, Z.
source.title: Systematical Study on the Influencing Factors of Synchronous Thermal Analyses of Samples-Taking the Chalcanthite as an Example

entries.note: 'pure chalcanthite', 9.6 mg (also 5.2 and 28.7 mg), alumina crucible; Atmosphäre: air; Peaks and losses are for 9.6 mg at 5 K/min (Tables 1-2). Te at 10 K/min, 9.6 mg (Table 3): 55.63, 80.20, 101.26, 116.31 and 226.91 °C. The paper's steps (dehydration only, run to 400 °C) are tabulated without assigning which H2O each one is. A 28.7 mg sample merges the steps into 3 (peaks 85.63, 113.87, 237.09 °C). Measured totals of 28.8-34.6 % are below the theoretical 36.08 %, suggesting partial efflorescence. Good evidence for the effect of mass and heating rate.; Onset: Te / extrapolated initial temperature Te at 5 K/min (Table 3)
